about.headline: I build AI systems that think, reason, and deliver results.
paragraphs: I'm Kunal Deshmukh — an AI/ML Engineer specializing in Agentic AI, Generative AI, and production-grade machine learning systems. I bridge the gap between cutting-edge research and real-world business impact.

My work spans end-to-end ML pipelines, LLM-powered applications, and computer vision systems — built with a focus on explainability, reliability, and fast iteration. I believe AI should be a tool you can trust, not a black box you hope works.

Since completing my Bachelor of Data Science at SPPU (June 2025), I've shipped projects that cut analysis effort by 60%, achieve 95%+ detection accuracy, and help organizations make smarter, faster decisions.
about.availability: Open to full-time AI/ML roles and select freelance/contract engagements

featured_projects.name: cloud-cost-forecasting-engine
featured_projects.description: Agentic AI Cloud Cost Forecasting Engine using React, Flask, Prophet, XGBoost and Llama 3. Reduces manual analysis effort by 60% with natural language cost insights.

featured_projects.name: MIDC-Project-Approval-Risk-Predictor
featured_projects.description: AI-powered evaluation desk for MIDC — a 10-agent LangGraph pipeline that automates risk scoring, generates explainable reports, and flags high-risk submissions before human review.

featured_projects.name: society-compliance-copilot
featured_projects.description: AI-powered Society Compliance Chatbot built with FastAPI, LangChain, and RAG. Helps housing societies instantly query bylaws, rules, and compliance requirements in natural language.

value_props.title: End-to-End Builder
value_props.description: From data pipeline to deployed API to polished UI — I own the full stack. No handoff gaps, no black holes between ML and product.

value_props.title: Explainable AI, Not Black Boxes
value_props.description: Every model I ship comes with interpretability built in. Stakeholders get clear reasoning, not just a score they have to trust blindly.

value_props.title: Fast Iteration, Real Impact
value_props.description: I move from idea to working prototype quickly, test with real data, and iterate until the numbers move. Shipping beats planning.
